# ExpoToFunnel

> ExpoToFunnel is a B2B trade show intelligence and meeting-booking platform
> operated by LeadStrategus, a demand generation and go-to-market consulting firm
> based in Bangalore, India. It indexes 17,007 B2B trade shows across 129
> countries and ranks them by ICP density - the share of attendees matching a
> company's ideal customer profile - then books qualified meetings with matched
> attendees before the event and provides a talking-points brief for each meeting.

## Key facts

- Index size: 17,007 B2B trade shows across 129 countries
- Core metric: ICP Density Score
- Grading: letter fit grade across five weighted factors
- Free tier (Discover): top 6 ranked shows, ICP counts, fit grades, dates,
  written rationale and a PDF report. No credit card, no time limit, no sales call.
- Time to result: 90 seconds from a six-field form
- Starter Pack: from $4,000 for 10 confirmed qualified meetings
- Growth Pack: from $6,000 for 20 confirmed qualified meetings plus a named
  ICP account list
- Full Takeover: custom pricing, 50+ meetings per flagship event, dedicated
  researcher, on-site coordination, written outcomes guarantee
- Qualified meeting: a confirmed meeting slot with a decision maker or
  influencer at a company matching the client's target industry, persona and
  geography, secured through pre-event outreach
- Serves both attendees (sales, BD, founders travelling without a booth) and
  exhibitors (seeking qualified booth traffic)
